description: This file defines the ConnectionLifecycle interface for managing the lifecycle of a connection to a Hono service, including methods for connecting, disconnecting, and adding listeners for connection events.

classes.name: ConnectionLifecycle
classes.description: Interface providing methods to manage the connection lifecycle to a Hono service, including connection establishment, disconnection, and event listener management.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the underlying AMQP connection to the service, returning a Future that completes with the connection or fails with an exception.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be notified when the connection is lost unexpectedly.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be notified when the connection has been re-established after being lost.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the connection is currently established, returning a Future that succeeds if connected or fails otherwise.

methods.name: isConnected (with timeout)
methods.description: Default method that checks connection status with a timeout, returning the same as isConnected().

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the service without automatic reconnection.

methods.name: disconnect (with handler)
methods.description: Disconnects from the service and notifies the caller of the outcome via a handler.
